question: Are the four proposed mechanisms (IPFC, SCDR, CRN, LTM) demonstrably novel, identifiable, and cheaper or better than simplest exact controls before any mechanism tuning?
hypothesis: (IPFC) On YNCA05 independent Boolean law family, greedy maximal pairwise disagreement ties exact one-step expected-information-gain in both probe sequence and residual law count, so no superiority claim is possible. (SCDR) topological cycle rank does not establish latent state, and naive contradiction alarms under 5% independent sensor noise fail 5% false-positive control; a calibrated noise-aware signal must be a comparator. (CRN) With no context evidence, any allosteric mechanism has no information advantage over a correctly specified Bayesian permutation mixture; multiplying reaction weights by the same likelihood is algebraically Bayes. (LTM) On exactly addressed deterministic 20-of-100 bit changes, a simple sparse direct repair attains zero forgotten and changed-bit errors in 20 direct updates, so thermal melting cannot claim accuracy superiority on this fixture.

predecessor_evidence.note: YNCA05 64-law exact identifiability proof and Bayes/cheap-candidate comparison; no reuse of protected original scientific data
CKAD22 cumulative native learner has 5 development gates pass but exact conventional online mixture ties; don't edit CKAD
Sheaf cohomological obstruction can witness contextuality for a specified model, not universal proof of physical hidden-state cause
Landauer erasure bound applies to logically irreversible erasure, not a direct CPU bit-update energy benchmark

inputs.name: Entire combinatorial source-free protocol; YNCA05-style 64 conditional Boolean laws, deterministic 3-node cycle, 5% independent sensor flip null, three equally likely hidden contexts and 100 direct-addressed bit rules
inputs.source: research/contrib/chatgpt/YNCA-06-QUAL/qualify.py; frozen source commit d935c1dcc545c3c5e90167372cd96d4be1865dea, Git blob fc069cdd8591740ab2331d67d5199fd946c3b5a3

frozen_design.kind: Zero-tuning analytical/development Stage-0 screening only; exact code source hash and commit to be bound before first result
frozen_design.seeds: None. Exhaustive deterministic enumeration / closed-form binomial tails, no stochastic sampling or real-first-use cohorts
frozen_design.split: No held-out statistical dataset, no original-source data, no changes to CKAD; all cases exhaustive/deductive. Any subsequent structural mechanism needs separate new prereg, independent heldout, stronger matched baselines.
frozen_design.ordering: GitHub prereg commit -> source commit+SHA lock -> source tests + original Stage0 result on Linux and Windows -> no retuning; preserve negative as legitimate gate closure
frozen_design.data_budget: 64 exhaustive Boolean tables conditioned f(0)=0, f(7)=1; 6 offdiagonal actions; 3-node deterministic cycle; 100 independent paired sensor reads, p_flip=0.05; 3 equally likely no-cue context classes; 100 directly addressed binary causal rules with exactly 20 changed
frozen_design.compute_budget: CPython 3.12 stdlib, 1 minute budget each Linux/Windows job, no GPU/purchased APIs
frozen_design.capacity: No trained network, no parameter optimization, no learned world models. Exact Bayes/EIG, naive contradiction alert, calibrated binomial null, Bayes/replicator identity, sparse direct edit, all analytic
frozen_design.evaluator: Stage0: count independent 64-law equivalence candidates after 2 probes, prove IPFC-disagreement vs EIG tie; compute naive SCDR null FPR and calibrated FPR/TPR; compare no-cue CRN prior expected accuracy/Bayes identity; sparse direct update untouched error and changed-bit error with 20 writes. All source-only and deterministic.

controls: Exact one-step Bayesian information gain + deterministic tie break and full version-space count (IPFC)
No-latent fully observed deterministic 3-cycle and calibrated binomial noise control (SCDR)
Exact Bayesian mixture over three permutation contexts given identical observations (CRN)
Sparse direct edit with perfect addressed feedback as strongest zero-forgetting baseline (LTM)
metrics: IPFC vs exact EIG path equality, residual class count
SCDR false positive in homogeneous-noise null and parity alternative detection
CRN no-cue best expected accuracy and Bayes/replicator numerical identity
LTM unchanged and changed bit errors, direct edit count
Source/runtime hashes and dual-OS deterministic parity

classification_rules.supported: STAGE0_PASS_TO_TARGETED_EXPERIMENT only when proposal demonstrates a mathematically distinct, testable mechanism with a plausible measurable advantage on a *new structured setting* under identical information/compute; Stage0 observations themselves cannot claim SCIENTIFIC_PASS or model improvement.
classification_rules.mixed: An idea has a useful revised testable variant but fails uniqueness or information-control in its provided toy fixture: REFORMULATE_ONLY. Freeze an entirely new source and strong comparator before any expensive training.
classification_rules.negative: Stop expensive implementation/tuning if the provided fixture yields identical predictions to exact Bayes/EIG, a false hidden-state proof, noise-only false alarms >5%, or no gain beyond exact local repair. Explicitly classify each proposal's original claim separately.
classification_rules.invalid: Changed thresholds, source unpinned before original run, partial law enumeration, inconsistent cross-OS metrics, label/latent input leakage, or missing controls makes screen INVALID.

IPFC.promote_only_if: new structured/shifted causal laws; same action/evidence/compute; <=0.8x number of distinct probes vs exact Bayesian EIG and >=0.95x downstream decision reward; <=30% redundant probes; 3 frozen seeds with independent cohorts; NO tuning on heldout
IPFC.abort_if: equality to EIG in presented 64-rule setting; fixed hypothesis set without independent falsifier-generated new counterexample worlds

SCDR.promote_only_if: mathematically defined sheaf stalks/restrictions and reproducible actual obstruction; noisy null FPR <=5%, true hidden parity TPR>=95%, no more than 2x true latent states; outperform matched fully fitted 2-state HMM/POMDP and history model on new worlds
SCDR.abort_if: topological cycle rank or raw repeated noisy outcome alone used as proof of hidden latent state

CRN.promote_only_if: specified mass-action ODE/rates plus stable bounded concentrations and actual composition change; adapt <=20 observations after switch; >=95% reward of exact online Bayesian mixture and >=1.5x better whole-process cost or strictly better independent shift transfer at equal compute
CRN.abort_if: only Bayesian weight update under chemical names, hidden context with no discriminating observation, or no physically measured resource benefit

LTM.promote_only_if: specified energy/update budget + physically meaningful measured cost, 6 frozen causal worlds; untouched rule degradation <=5%, changed adaptation <=2x sparse conditional update and trained forgetting/EWC controls, >=1.5x end-to-end cost improvement with no reward loss
LTM.abort_if: direct-indexed deterministic sparse update already zero-forgetting; replacing CPU operations count with kT ln2 without measuring actual irreversible erasure

prohibited_after_primary_run: claiming analytic screens are native training
merging or promoting Yggdrasil learning state
using YNCA05 or CKAD heldout as fresh scientific data
preregistration_note: Exact Stage0 source SHA-256 pinned before first actual original evaluator run. No protected science test; source-free analytic early stop only; no parameter tuning.
